title: Activation-Guided Graph Retrieval for Cognitive Memory Reconstruction in Language Model Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.13127v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented language model systems generally select context by query-conditioned relevance. We argue that long-lived AI systems require a second operator: activation-conditioned memory availability. We specify an architecture in which request and goal cues seed an authorized memory graph, activation and fan attenuation allocate a bounded traversal frontier, retrieved entities recursively emit cues, and a typed evidence graph is reconstructed before generation. The specification yields five architectural consequences about candidate selection, traversal control, graph regularization, evidence reconstruction, and reinforcement. We derive implementation-level cost estimates and define ablations, failure conditions, and a reproducible evaluation protocol. The central claim is narrowed or falsified if a simpler graph reranker matches full traversal on causal and temporal recovery under equal budgets. This architecture-and-analysis pre

translated_title: 面向语言模型系统中认知记忆重构的激活引导图检索
translated_abstract: 检索增强语言模型系统通常通过基于查询条件的相关性来选择上下文。我们认为，长寿命AI系统需要第二种算子：激活条件化的记忆可用性。我们规定了一种架构，其中请求与目标线索为授权的记忆图进行播种，激活与扇出衰减分配有界的遍历前沿，检索到的实体递归地发射线索，并在生成之前重构类型化证据图。该规范产生了关于候选选择、遍历控制、图正则化、证据重构和强化的五项架构性推论。我们推导了实现层面的成本估计，并定义了消融实验、失败条件以及可复现的评估协议。如果在同等预算下，一个更简单的图重排序器在因果与时间恢复任务上能够匹配完整遍历的效果，则该核心主张将被收窄或证伪。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种激活条件化的记忆图检索架构，通过请求与目标线索激活授权记忆图、扇出衰减控制有界遍历、实体递归发射线索，并在生成前重构类型化证据图，从而为长寿命AI系统实现认知记忆重构。
